limits: Requires a KaiCalls account on any paid plan (Kai Backup $10/mo, Kai Answering $79/mo, Kai Office $349/mo; 7-day free trial, cancel anytime). Service is for US business phone numbers. The OAuth consent screen binds each connection to a single business the user belongs to, and every tool call is limited to that business. What the connector can do depends on the scopes the user approves: read scopes cover calls, transcripts, recordings, voicemail, leads, SMS history and analytics; write scopes are needed to update leads, send texts, place calls, or change alerts. Outbound calls and texts go through KaiCalls' compliance checks (opt-out, Do-Not-Call and quiet hours) and are metered against the plan. List endpoints return at most 100 records per request. Rate limits are fair use, and sustained abuse gets HTTP 429.
extraNotes:
KaiCalls is an AI secretary and answering service for small businesses. It answers missed and after-hours calls, captures each caller as a lead, writes a transcript and summary, texts the caller the next step, and alerts the owner. The KaiCalls connector lets someone ask Muse who called, what they wanted, which leads are new, and what happens next, and then act on it by updating a lead, texting a caller back, or placing a preview call.

Technical notes for review:
- Hosted remote MCP server, Streamable HTTP (JSON-RPC 2.0 over POST): https://www.kaicalls.com/api/mcp. It is in production today and also listed in the MCP Registry as com.kaicalls/kaicalls.
- OAuth 2.1: authorization code + PKCE (S256), refresh tokens, Dynamic Client Registration (RFC 7591), and Client ID Metadata Documents. Discovery: https://www.kaicalls.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource and https://www.kaicalls.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server. Unauthenticated requests return 401 with WWW-Authenticate resource_metadata. If Muse needs a pre-registered static client and redirect URI instead of DCR, contact connor@kaicalls.com.
- A scoped API key (kc_live_*) is also accepted as a Bearer token or in X-KaiCalls-API-Key.
- Every tool carries MCP annotations (readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, idempotentHint, openWorldHint). Full inventory: https://www.kaicalls.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json and https://github.com/KaiCalls/kaicalls-mcp.
- Safety: tools that place calls or send texts are write-scoped, idempotency-keyed, compliance-gated and audited. Billing tools only return a Stripe-hosted checkout link that the owner opens and approves; the connector never charges a card or takes payment inside Muse.
- A test account for end-to-end review is available on request from connor@kaicalls.com.
